details:
Dear VRChat Team,

Thank you for your continuous hard work in developing VRChat. I am writing to provide feedback regarding a recent UI change on the VRChat website.

Currently, it has become very difficult to distinguish between "Online" and "Offline" status at a glance on the friend list. This change has significantly reduced the usability of the website for me.

I personally enjoy supporting world creators by checking their activity and staying connected with long-time friends. However, with the current UI, I have to open each individual profile to see their status. It is no longer possible to see "who is currently working hard" or "who is online" in a single view as I could before.

While I understand that security and privacy are important considerations, could you please reconsider a design that allows us to intuitively identify online status—such as through distinct colors or icons—directly within the friend list?

Being able to quickly see my friends' status is vital for maintaining our community connections. I would greatly appreciate your consideration of this improvement.
title: Feedback on Friend Online Status Visibility on the VRChat Website
